title: Keletso e Ngotsoeng ka Bohlale
intro: Ak'u nahane u eme pela motho ea tsebahalang eseng ka mehlolo kapa mebuso, empa ka mantsoe a ntseng a tataisa lipelo le kajeno. Mohlanka enoa oa Allah o ile a fumana mpho ea bohlokoa 'me a tšela teboho keletsong e 'ngoe le e 'ngoe e fuoang moithuti e monyenyane ea ratoang.
clues: Ke hlohonolofalitsoe ke Allah ka bohlale, 'me ke laetsoe hore ke bo lebohe.
Ke buile le mora oa ka ka keletso e bonolo, ke mo lemosa ka lerato le kameho.
Ke ile ka bolella mora oa ka hore ho kopanya balekane le Allah ke phoso e kholo.
Ke ile ka eletsa mora oa ka ho theha thapelo, ho laela se nepahetseng, ho thibela se fosahetseng, le ho mamella ka mamello.
Ke ile ka lemosa mora oa ka hore a se ke a retelehela lerama ka boikhohomoso kapa a se ke a tsamaea lefatšeng ka boikhohomoso.
Ke rutile mora oa ka ho ba le lebelo le itekanetseng le ho theola lentsoe, hobane molumo o matla ka ho fetisisa ke oa litonki.

outcome.answer: E le mohlala oa teboho le keletso e bohlale ea batsoali

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
